newsitem.title: USA: Visx laser gets FDA advisory panel OK.
newsitem.headline: Visx laser gets FDA advisory panel OK.

text.p: VISX Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration Ophthalmic Devices Advisory Panel has recommended approval of its Excimer Laser Systems for use in the treatment of low to moderate nearsightedness with myopic astigmatism.
The company said in a statement the panel reviewed data from five U.S. sites as well as data from well controlled studies in Canada and the United Kingdom.

"The panel's recommendation has acknowledged that approval of the VISX laser for the treatment of astigmatism will give consumers a safe alternative to AK, an invasive surgical technique," said Mark Logan, VISX's chairman and chief executive officer.

"With well over 50 percent of the nearsighted population having some degree of astigmatism, I think it is safe to assume that final FDA approval will lead to greater consumer satisfaction and an increase in the overall number of procedures performed in the U.S.," he added.
